itens.titulo: JPMorgan profit rises 6% but misses third-quarter forecasts
itens.descricao: JPMorgan profit rises 6% but misses third-quarter forecasts Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: JPMorgan Chase & Co (NYSE:JPM, XETRA:CMC), the US banking group, reported third-quarter net income of $15.3 billion, up 6% year on year, but missed analysts' forecasts for earnings and revenue.
The bank earned $5.57 per share on reported revenue of $50.2 billion, below market expectations of $5.93 per share and $51.23 billion in revenue.
A $658 million loss on investment securities reduced earnings per share by $0.18, while net income excluding the item reached $15.8 billion, or $5.75 per share.

Managed revenue, which adjusts reported figures to help assess business performance, rose 8% to $50.9 billion, supported by stronger interest income and higher revenue across several operating divisions.
Net interest income, the difference between interest earned and interest paid, increased 13% to $27.1 billion, reflecting higher deposit balances and growth in card and wholesale lending.
Market revenue climbed 15% to $10.3 billion, driven by a 49% increase in equity trading, which offset a 4% decline in fixed-income markets revenue.
Investment banking fees increased 14% to $3 billion, primarily because of higher advisory fees, while revenue at the asset and wealth management division rose 14% to $6.9 billion.
Consumer and community banking revenue increased 9% to $21.2 billion, supported by card services, auto lending and wealth management, while the bank added more than 650,000 net new checking accounts.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, and Citi earnings show consumers holding up despite high rates
itens.descricao: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, and Citi earnings show consumers holding up despite high rates Yahoo Finance
trechos: JPMorgan's average credit card loans rose 7% from a year earlier, with card charge-offs falling to 2.91% from 3.15%.
Consumer loan balances at Wells Fargo rose 4%, with the credit card charge-off rate falling to 3.73% from 4.02%.
Citigroup reported US card spending rose 11% over the same period, while charge-offs improved to a rate of 3.6%, down from 4.0% a year earlier.
"Our data shows that our consumer and business customers are doing well," Wells Fargo CEO Charlie Scharf said Tuesday.

"Consumers are spending more, loan delinquencies are low, and deposit and investment balances have grown." Scharf said AI infrastructure investment, high employment and wage growth continue to outweigh the risks from higher rates, oil prices and inflation.

trechos: As of October 12, Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) shares have climbed about 3% over the past five days.
The rally began after Q3 deliveries came in at 486,532, well above the roughly 462,000 analysts expected.
Deliveries were still down about 2% from a year earlier, though.
Even after the bounce, the stock is down about 15% this year.
All eyes are now on its Q3 earnings, due October 21.

itens.descricao: Ibovespa cai após subir mais de 8% em uma semana; dólar avança e passa dos R$ 5 Exame
trechos: B3: bancos, varejo e construtoras lideram perdas nesta terça-feira.
Por volta das 10h25 (horário de Brasília), o principal índice da B3 recuava 1,15%, aos 206.663 pontos.
O dólar comercial subia 0,68%, cotado a R$ 5,01.
PETR3 sobe 0,65% e PETR4 avança 0,50%.
Localiza (RENT3) recua 4,93%, C&A (CEAB3) cai 4,49%, Assaí (ASAI3) perde 3,84%, MRV (MRVE3) também cede 3,84% e Tenda (TEND3) recua 3,66%.

Os bancos também pressionam o índice, e Itaú (ITUB4) recua 2,04%, Bradesco cai 1,80% (BBDC4) e 2% (BBDC3), Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) perde 1,62% e BTG Pactual (BPAC11, do mesmo grupo controlador da EXAME) recua 2,47%.

"O mercado, imagino, é relativamente tranquilo, acompanhando as bolsas lá fora também um certo tom de cautela, petróleo no patamar bastante elevado, mas acompanhando muito de perto aqui também as pesquisas eleitorais", afirma.
Hoje, a Pesquisa Gerp mostra Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) com 55% dos votos válidos no 2º turno, contra 45% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).

itens.titulo: JPMorgan Chase Misses Third-Quarter Earnings Estimates as Fixed-Income Trading Revenue Declines
itens.descricao: JPMorgan Chase Misses Third-Quarter Earnings Estimates as Fixed-Income Trading Revenue Declines Yahoo Finance
trechos: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) reported third-quarter 2026 earnings below Wall Street expectations, as weaker fixed-income trading revenue and investment securities losses weighed on the largest US bank's financial performance.
The bank posted net income of $15.31 billion, equivalent to $5.57 per share, for the quarter ended 30 September.
Analysts surveyed by Bloomberg had expected earnings of $5.92 per share.
Adjusted revenue increased 8% year on year to $50.9 billion but fell short of the $51.37 billion consensus forecast.
Fixed-income markets revenue declined 4% to $5.4 billion, reflecting weaker activity across several trading categories.
Investment banking fees, however, increased 14% to $3 billion, supported by stronger advisory revenue.
Quarterly Earnings Fall Short of Analyst Forecasts JPMorgan reported third-quarter net income of $15.31 billion, with earnings per share of $5.57.
The result was $0.35 below the consensus estimate of $5.92 per share.

itens.descricao: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) reported $50.17 billion in revenue for the quarter ended September 2026, representing a year-over-year increase of 8.1%.
EPS of $5.75 for the same period compares to $5.07 a year ago.
The reported revenue represents a surprise of -3.9% over the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $52.21 billion.
With the consensus EPS estimate being $5.94, the EPS surprise was -3.2%.

Here is how JPMorgan Chase & Co. performed in the just reported quarter in terms of the metrics most widely monitored and projected by Wall Street analysts: - Book value per share: $132.30 versus $134.63 estimated by three analysts on average.
- Net charge-off/(recovery) rates - Total retained loans: 0.6% compared to the 0.6% average estimate based on three analysts.
- Average Balances - Total interest-earning assets: $4336.22 billion versus the two-analyst average estimate of $4352.63 billion.
- Tier 1 Capital Ratio - Standardized: 14.8% versus the two-analyst average estimate of 15%.
